<function name="SelectNone" parent="Panel" type="classfunc">
	<description>Deselects all items in a panel object. For text-based objects, this will deselect all text.

<note>Only works on <page>RichText</page> and <page>TextEntry</page> and their derived panels by default (such as <page>DTextEntry</page>), and on any panel that manually reimplemented this method.</note>
</description>
	<realm>Client and Menu</realm>
</function>
